title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, Web UI, and MCP server. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the REST API, and static HTML/JS for the client-side web UI. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth and logging. GitHub Actions automate weekly reindexing.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI. Deploy to AWS for production use or embed the widget in other sites.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories
CLI, Web UI, and MCP server interfaces for AI agents
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Embeddable widget and shareable search URLs
